item.title: 【Helpdesk】decent Dolby Atmos downloader?
item.description:
Now that the Yaronzz downloader has officially fizzled out - doesn't work no matter what you do and hasn't been updated in ~4 years, we don't have a working Atmos downloader.

The revived NG version is pure retardation - downloads LQ 3-4mb 2ch M4A's instead of 6ch proper quality Atmos M4A's that are around 15-35mb.

And the GUI version of Yaronzz's downloader has never been able to download Atmos even when you select the Atmos version of the release, just downloads everything to 2ch FLAC.

So where do we get our Atmos stuff from now?
